notes: Big-endian int16 (SignedMSB2). No scaling or offset: values are meters.
Median of MOLA shots per 1/128 deg bin. Bins with no shots are INTERPOLATED, so slope in those areas is not measured.
Only about 55% of bins near the equator contain at least one shot; gaps between profiles up to 12 km.
ENVI header says 'data ignore value = 0' but 0 m is a valid elevation and the label says gaps are interpolated, so zeros are NOT masked.
Pixel width in meters shrinks with cos(latitude); slope code accounts for this.
Slope baseline here is ~926 m (central difference over 2 pixels), much coarser than the LOLA map. Not directly comparable.
